summary: Placed all six target boxes on their assigned platforms within the specified layer regions. Box1 and Box2 are on Platform1 in Region1; Box3 and Box4 are on Platform2 in Region2; Box5 and Box6 are on Platform3 in Region3. All boxes have their bottom faces resting exactly on the top surface of their respective platforms (y = platform_top + box_height/2). The full bounding boxes are contained within the region limits, avoiding overlaps with other boxes, fixed shelves, and the keep-out channel. No unauthorized changes were made to protected objects.
limitations: Final compare_state diagnostic was skipped due to finish_only mode activation after check_constraints passed.
